changes.evidence: M.O.D.O.K. and Hit-Monkey are one reality, Earth-1226 (Marvel Database: 'The reality of Marvel's M.O.D.O.K. and Marvel's Hit-Monkey'). This log's own recaps mark it terminated only at Hit-Monkey ('On the TVA's monitors, Earth-1226 is marked terminated'); the M.O.D.O.K. recap has no termination. So the 51st termination is shown one title early. Moving the stage to Hit-Monkey matches the recap and the earlier stages (Hulk TV films, Ghost Rider, Ultimate Avengers, which count at a world's last title).

Every Marvel Rising title (Initiation to Playing with Fire) is one reality, Earth-18878 (Marvel Database). This log's recaps mark Earth-18878 terminated only at Marvel Rising: Playing with Fire; the Initiation recap has no termination. The stage is shown seven titles before the title that reveals it.

owner_calls.question: From stage 37 on, both Incursions logs put each new count at a world's FIRST title, but the recaps mark that world terminated at its LAST title (earlier stages, 0 to 36, count at the last title). Move all of them to the terminating title, as proposed for stages 48 and 50?
options: Move every stage to the title whose recap marks the world terminated: Iron Man (2010) to Avengers Confidential: Black Widow & Punisher (Earth-101001); Ultimate Spider-Man to Avengers: Secret Wars (2017) (Earth-12041); Iron Man & Hulk: Heroes United to Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United (Earth-TRN607); LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload to LEGO Marvel Avengers: Mission Demolition (Earth-13122); Big Hero 6 to Baymax! (Earth-14123); Guardians of the Galaxy (2015) to Avengers: Black Panther's Quest (Earth-17628); Marvel Rising: Initiation to Marvel Rising: Playing with Fire (Earth-18878); M.O.D.O.K. to Hit-Monkey (Earth-1226)
Keep the counts at each world's first title and remove the per-recap termination lines instead
owner_calls.evidence: Compared each stage title with the recap text in index.html: the recap carrying 'Earth-X is marked terminated' is the last title of each of those worlds, never the stage title. Marvel Database confirms the groupings, e.g. Earth-17628 = Guardians of the Galaxy (2015), Marvel's Spider-Man and Black Panther's Quest; Earth-1226 = M.O.D.O.K. and Hit-Monkey.
